blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) Civil Security Group said Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa has yet to surrender 91 firearms registered under his name after his gun licenses and registrations were revoked. “From 117, they have turned in 26, so we still have 91. We are continuing our coordination with his legal officer,” PNP CSG Director Maj. Gen. Aden Lagradante said in a press briefing on Monday. The PNP Firearms and Explosives Office (PNP-FEO) has revoked dela Rosa’s firearms licenses and registrations, with the order dated May 26 and signed by FEO chief Brig. Gen. Jose Manalad Jr. […]...
